name: Skincare Retailer Lead Generation Pipeline (Portfolio Demo)

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger — Disabled until testing is complete

parameters.content:
## Stage A — Discovery
Manual Trigger, Serper search per country and category (edit the list in "Build Search Queries"). Serper errors become error items and are logged, not dropped.

## Stage B–C — Normalise and de-duplicate
Canonical registrable domain (handles .co.uk and .com.au). Same-batch duplicates are merged and counted. Invalid URLs go to the log.

## Stage D — Airtable persistence
Search by canonical_domain. Update if found, create if not. Record id is carried forward so reruns do not create duplicates.

## Stage E–F — Enrichment and qualification
Fetch homepage and About/Contact/Brands pages. Gemini extracts structured JSON from that text only. Deterministic code validates it (quotes must exist in the page text, sources must be fetched URLs), retries once, then qualifies by rules. LLM cannot override hard exclusions.

## Stage G–I — Contact status, write-back and summary
Email syntax only, no SMTP probing. Each lead is written back to Airtable. After the loop, the summary counts are computed from records touched by this execution.
